### TAG-150: Null Convention Library and ABI Spec

**Status:** ⬜ Not started

## Software Notes

Define a foundational NCL signal interface for generated VHDL. The initial representation will use a bundled signal format, `{data[6:0], valid}`, where `valid = '0'` represents NULL and `valid = '1'` represents DATA. Centralize payload extraction, NULL/DATA construction, completion detection, and related helpers in a reusable MatterScript NCL VHDL package. IL-generated modules should use completeness-driven behavior rather than clocked control; the existing clocked FSM backend may remain separate during migration. This issue establishes the signal ABI and reusable library boundary, while later issues will implement mutex, conditional, arbitration, NULL return, and full NCL sequencing semantics.

## Reference

```
package matterscript_ncl is
  constant DATA_WIDTH : natural := 7;
  constant SIGNAL_WIDTH : natural := DATA_WIDTH + 1;

  function is_data(signal_value : std_logic_vector) return boolean;
  function is_null(signal_value : std_logic_vector) return boolean;
  function payload(signal_value : std_logic_vector) return std_logic_vector;
  function data_value(value : natural) return std_logic_vector;
end package;
```
